Class Space

java.lang.Object
ru.yanes.models.Space
public class Space extends Object
A class representing the space between two adjacent teeth.

A space can contain up to two toothbrushes: an inner toothbrush and an outer toothbrush. The inner toothbrush is positioned closer to the center of the mouth, while the outer toothbrush is positioned further from the center. If no toothbrush is installed, the corresponding field is null.

A space's availability is determined by the availability of at least one of its teeth. Installing or clearing a toothbrush is only possible for an available space; otherwise, an IllegalStateException is thrown. Furthermore, installing an inner toothbrush requires that the outer toothbrush be absent (and vice versa) to avoid overlapping two toothbrushes in the same space. *

The @Data annotation from Lombok automatically generates getters and setters for non-final fields, as well as the equals(), hashCode(), and toString() methods. A constructor with parameters for the final fields leftTooth, rightTooth, and position is also generated by Lombok (if the class has no other constructors).

    • isAvailable

      public boolean isAvailable()
      Checks if a space is accessible. A space is considered accessible if at least one of its teeth (leftTooth or rightTooth) is accessible.
      Returns:
      true if the space is accessible for toothbrush placement, otherwise false

    • setInnerBrush

      public void setInnerBrush(Brush brush)
      Sets the inner brush for the gap.

      Setting is only possible if the gap is available (isAvailable() returns true) and the outer brush is not installed (isOuterEmpty() returns true). If the same brush is passed that is already set as the inner brush, it is removed (the value becomes null).

      Parameters:
      brush - - the brush to set; if null, the method does not change the state.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the gap is unavailable or the outer brush is already installed.

    • setOuterBrush

      public void setOuterBrush(Brush brush)
      Sets the outer brush for the gap.

      Can only be set if the gap is available (isAvailable() returns true) and the inner brush is not set (isInnerEmpty() returns true). If the same brush is passed that is already set as the outer brush, it is removed (the value becomes null).

      Parameters:
      brush - - the brush to set; if null, the method does not change the state.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the gap is unavailable or the inner brush is already set.
